name: Galuf's Final Act
clause: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains "When ~ dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on up to one target creature."

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'grant-ability-to'; target: TargetSpec | Ref | 'creatures-you-control' | 'all-creatures'; ability: Ability; duration: 'eot' | 'permanent' }
needs.semantics: Grants a whole quoted ability (not just keywords) to the objects the target resolves to, at layer 6, for a duration. Today `gain-ability` only pushes onto the SOURCE's grantedAbilities, so 'target creature ... gains "When this creature dies, ..."' is unwritable.
needs.clause: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains "When ~ dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on up to one target creature."
